title: Paths... popover -> settings WIZARD: design the flow (mockup first), then implement
description:
DIRECTION CHANGE 2026-07-21 (supersedes the earlier two-section-popover mockup): the Paths... popover should become a settings WIZARD:
- screen 1: set the project path
- screen 2: 'do you wish to set a custom file history snapshot path or auto-derive the path?'
- screen 3: 'do you wish to set a Git Repo path?'
- screen 4: 'do you wish to pick a git repo commit? (default: master branch tip)'
DELIVERABLE ORDER: (a) define the wizard's flow logic via UI/UX MOCKUP first, (b) define how values are CHANGED for a session after it loads (re-enter the wizard? jump to a single screen? a compact summary panel with per-row edit?), (c) only then implement. The user says ambiguities must be flushed out first — resolve these in the mockup step:
(1) TRIGGER: when does the wizard run — first launch with no config? every folder switch? on demand from the Paths... button? (screen 1 is GLOBAL config, screens 2-4 are effectively per-project — reveng-paths.json entries — so does the wizard rerun per project?)
(2) Screen-2 default: auto-derive (today's behavior — empty posts '' and the server re-derives, app-header.ts computeFileHistoryDirToPost).
(3) Screen-4 default 'master branch tip': which ref when the repo's default branch isn't master, and should the default instead be the commit the SESSION records (the s85-style recorded baseline) when one exists?
(4) Skip semantics: declining screens 3/4 must leave the project reconstructing exactly as with no reveng-paths entry.
(5) Persistence: where each screen's answer lands (screen 1 -> /api/config global; screens 2-4 -> /api/project-paths, persist flag) and whether the wizard's finish step is the 137-style 'store?' prompt.
(6) The task-56 pre-baseline question ('reconstruct file states preceding the baseline commit?') fires at project load — decide whether it becomes a wizard screen or stays a load-time dialog.
CARRY-OVERS still wanted from the pre-wizard design: picker-button naming 'Set Projects Folder location' / 'Set Git Repo location'; Store subsumes Apply (postProjectPaths(true) applies AND persists, app-paths-project.ts:122-123); commit pick list = task 154's 500-newest list (search box open there). title: Phase-4 blowup: nested lineage replays re-run the full per-target pipeline once per (target, timestamp)
description: ROOT CAUSE of the task-156 stall (2252s+ observed on the 451-target RevEng project, 2026-07-21; task 150's garbage-target fix addressed a different symptom). Evidence from jfred-server.log (70s window): 473 'replaying lineage of' headers over only 140 distinct targets — one target replayed 27x, another 56x (sic, from the script-stage tally); plans/items29-30-31-32-close.md replayed 3x in 47s. Mechanism: replayLineageContentBefore (src/reconstruction_branches.ts:199) replays a target's ENTIRE reconstruction pipeline once per (target, before-timestamp) cycleKey, and each replay re-runs every stage including injectScriptExecutions over ALL 1447 discovered runs ('script stage: 1447 runs for <target>' x473). The lineageSeedsByKey memo only caches replays entered on a CLEAN seeding stack (enteredWithCleanStack, lines 207-225) — nested replays recompute fresh every time and are never cached. Also observed: placeGitCommitEvidence is the slowest per-replay stage (0.16-0.37s each; the logged run's last line sat there). Fix directions to evaluate in planning: (a) safely memoize nested replays (the current guard exists because a nested replay's result can be degraded by outer cycle guards — cache only proven-undegraded results, or key the cache by the active seeding stack); (b) compute a target's full revision list ONCE and slice per `before` — CAUTION: enterLineageReplayWindow(before) sets a time cutoff that changes reconstruction (the s87 time-aware indirection), so slicing is only valid where the cutoff provably doesn't alter the prefix; (c) hoist the 1447-run script-run discovery/filtering out of the per-replay path. Reproduce: load project -Users-matkatmusicllc-Desktop-claude-code-src-RevEng with script consent, pipe server stdout to a log, count 'replaying lineage of' repeats per target.
